titleEn: Find the Minimum and Maximum Number of Nodes Between Critical Points
title: 找出临界点之间的最小和最大距离
summary: 链表内部节点若严格大于或小于两邻居则为临界点，返回任意相邻临界点最小距离及首尾临界点最大距离；不足两个返回负一。
insight: 一次遍历记录首个、上一个临界点下标。每发现新临界点，用与上一个的差更新最小值，用与首个的差自然形成最终最大值。
pitfalls: 头尾节点不能是临界点
不足两个临界点返回两个负一

solutions.title: 单遍临界下标
solutions.idea: 滚动三节点窗口并维护首个与最近临界位置。
steps: current 同时大于或小于两邻时处理临界下标
更新 first、last、minimum；最终若无两点返回 [-1,-1]，否则 [minimum,last-first]

code.java: class Solution { public int[] nodesBetweenCriticalPoints(ListNode head){ListNode previous=head,current=head.next;int index=1,first=-1,last=-1,minimum=Integer.MAX_VALUE;while(current.next!=null){if((current.val>previous.val&&current.val>current.next.val)||(current.val<previous.val&&current.val<current.next.val)){if(first<0)first=index;else minimum=Math.min(minimum,index-last);last=index;}previous=current;current=current.next;index++;}return minimum==Integer.MAX_VALUE?new int[]{-1,-1}:new int[]{minimum,last-first};} }
code.kotlin: class Solution { fun nodesBetweenCriticalPoints(head:ListNode?):IntArray{var previous=head!!;var current=head.next!!;var index=1;var first=-1;var last=-1;var minimum=Int.MAX_VALUE;while(current.next!=null){if((current.`val`>previous.`val`&&current.`val`>current.next!!.`val`)||(current.`val`<previous.`val`&&current.`val`<current.next!!.`val`)){if(first<0)first=index else minimum=minOf(minimum,index-last);last=index};previous=current;current=current.next!!;index++};return if(minimum==Int.MAX_VALUE)intArrayOf(-1,-1) else intArrayOf(minimum,last-first)} }
code.cpp: class Solution { public: vector<int> nodesBetweenCriticalPoints(ListNode* head){ListNode* previous=head,*current=head->next;int index=1,first=-1,last=-1,minimum=INT_MAX;while(current->next){if((current->val>previous->val&&current->val>current->next->val)||(current->val<previous->val&&current->val<current->next->val)){if(first<0)first=index;else minimum=min(minimum,index-last);last=index;}previous=current;current=current->next;++index;}return minimum==INT_MAX?vector<int>{-1,-1}:vector<int>{minimum,last-first};} };
